# University of Canberra Research Portal

> A comprehensive research discovery platform connecting researchers, expertise, and collaborative opportunities at the University of Canberra.

The UC Research Portal serves as a central hub for exploring researcher profiles, academic expertise, and research projects across the university. The platform emphasizes accessibility and inclusive design to ensure all users can discover and engage with research opportunities.

## Key Topics

- researcher profiles
- research expertise
- academic research
- research discovery
- collaboration platform
- research projects
- university directory
- WCAG compliance
- web accessibility
- screen reader support
- keyboard navigation
- disability support
- University of Canberra
- research portal
- accessibility statement

## Core Research Portal

- [University of Canberra Research Portal](https://researchprofiles.canberra.edu.au): Main portal homepage for discovering researcher profiles, expertise, and academic collaboration opportunities at UC

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility Statement](https://researchprofiles.canberra.edu.au/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance documentation, accessibility features, assistive technology support (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), and accessibility reporting guidelines
